Class LoginController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.Controllers.PreGame.LoginController
public class LoginController extends Object
Controller for the login screen. Handles user input for nickname, server IP, port, client IP and network type, validates the input and delegates the connection to the GUI layer.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the login screen. Sets default values for all input fields, configures the network combo box to auto-update the port when the protocol changes, disables the connect button until a nickname is entered, and applies the click effect and background.

    • setController

      public void setController(GUI gui)
      Injects the main GUI instance into this controller.
      Parameters:
      gui - the GUI instance

    • handleConnect

      public void handleConnect()
      Handles the connect button action. Reads all input fields and delegates the login to the GUI layer. Shows an error message if the port field does not contain a valid number.

    • showLoginError

      public void showLoginError(String errorMessage)
      Displays an error message on the login screen. Highlights the nickname field in red, clears its content and requests focus so the user can immediately type a new nickname.
      Parameters:
      errorMessage - the error message to display in the error label
